newsitem.title: USA: Life USA buys Creative Marketing interest.
newsitem.headline: Life USA buys Creative Marketing interest.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc, a financial services holding company, said Thursday it bought a minority interest in Creative Marketing International Corp for common stock and convertible-preferred stock.
Creative Marketing, based in Overland Park, Kan., is a national marketing company with a data base of more than 18,000 agents that produce annuity premiums of more than $150 million annually.

Creative Marketing had no prior affiliation with Life USA, but as a result of the transaction, the company will begin marketing LifeUSA life and annuity products as a national field marketing organisation.
